column1: # The schema of sde.conf (0.2.0 Alpha 4, docs/CORE.md "Settings"): what the
# SDE core controller (sde-core) accepts for a key, and the one page of the
# Every key of data/sde.conf is in the schema, also the commented
# "#key=value" ones: true/false defaults are booleans, whole numbers are
# integers, anything else is text. This file makes types stricter (ranges,
# value lists) and adds keys that data/sde.conf does not list. Keys that are
# in neither are accepted as text, and sde-core logs them.
# type:   bool, int (values "min..max"), int-or-auto ("auto" or an integer
#         in "min..max"), enum (values "a|b|c"; any case, written in lower
#         case), color (#RGB or #RRGGBB, written as #RRGGBB), time (HH:MM),
# page:   the Control Center page (sde-settings --page ID) that edits the
#         key, empty when no page does. tests/test_settings_pages.py checks
#         that no other page edits it.
